label.与前一段内容的间距，相对于组件大小。: Space from the previous item, relative to the component's size.
label.与前一段文字的间距，相对于组件大小。: Space from the previous text, relative to the component's size.
label.与屏幕边缘的距离，以屏幕短边的百分比计。: Distance from the screen edge, in percent of the screen's shorter side.
label.仅列出为所有用户安装的字体。: Only fonts installed for all users are listed.
label.以屏幕宽度的百分比计，正值向右。: In percent of the screen width; positive moves right.
label.以屏幕高度的百分比计。: In percent of the screen height.
label.以屏幕高度的百分比计，其他文字按比例缩放。: In percent of the screen height; the other text scales with it.
label.以屏幕高度的百分比计，正值向下。: In percent of the screen height; positive moves down.
label.使用电池供电时，显示预计剩余使用时间。: Shows the estimated time left when running on battery.
label.倒计时的目标日期，过期后不再显示。: The date to count down to. After it has passed, the component is hidden.
label.关闭后不显示该文字，也不占位。: When off, this text is not shown and takes no space.
label.关闭后不显示该进度条，也不占位。: When off, this bar is not shown and takes no space.
label.到上一行基线的距离，相对于组件大小。: Distance from the previous line's baseline, relative to the component's size.
label.在文字下方加深背景以提高可读性；为 0 时不显示。: Darkens the background behind the text to make it easier to read; at 0 nothing is drawn.
label.在时钟下方加深背景，提高在浅色壁纸上的可读性。: Darkens the background behind the clock to make it easier to read on light wallpapers.
label.在没有电池的设备上显示「交流电源」。: Shows “AC power” on devices without a battery.
label.在电量前显示电池图标，图标随电量和充电状态变化。: Shows a battery icon before the charge, following the charge level and charging status.
label.在组件下方显示半透明圆角底板，提高在浅色壁纸上的可读性。: Shows a translucent rounded plate behind the component for legibility on light wallpapers.
label.在进度条之后显示当前位置和总时长。: Shows the current position and the duration after the progress bar.
label.在进度条前显示播放或暂停图标。: Shows a play or pause icon before the progress bar.
label.壁纸开始显示后，延迟多久开始入场。: How long after the wallpaper appears the component starts to appear.
label.多行文字的对齐方式。: How lines of text align with each other.
label.天数文字的字号，以屏幕高度的百分比计。: The number of days' font size, in percent of the screen height.
label.字体不含所选字重时，使用最接近的字重。: If the font doesn't have this weight, the closest one is used.
label.悬挂时，该文字不参与各行之间的对齐，对齐以其余文字为准。: When hanging, this text is left out of aligning the lines; they align by the rest of the text.
label.接通电源时显示「正在充电」或「已接通电源」。: Shows “Charging” or “Plugged in” while on AC power.
label.整个组件的不透明度。: The opacity of the whole component.
label.文字到底板上下边缘的距离，相对于组件大小。: Space between the text and the plate's top and bottom edges, relative to the component's size.
label.文字到底板左右边缘的距离，相对于组件大小。: Space between the text and the plate's left and right edges, relative to the component's size.
label.无播放内容时显示提示: Show a message when nothing is playing
label.无电池时显示电源状态: Show power status without a battery
label.时间文字的字号，以屏幕高度的百分比计。: The time's font size, in percent of the screen height.
label.柔光向四周渐隐；圆角矩形是边缘清晰的底板。: A soft glow fades out on all sides; a rounded rectangle is a plate with clean edges.
label.标题文字的字号，以屏幕高度的百分比计。: The title's font size, in percent of the screen height.
label.没有正在播放的媒体时显示「未在播放」。: Shows “Not playing” when no media is playing.
label.电量数字的字号，以屏幕高度的百分比计。: The size of the charge figures, as a percentage of the screen height.
label.相对于本段文字的字号。: Relative to this text's font size.
label.相对于本行基线上移的距离，负值下移；相对于组件大小。: How far above the line's baseline it sits; negative values lower it. Relative to the component's size.
label.等宽数字在数值变化时宽度保持不变。: Tabular figures keep their width as the number changes.
label.组件在屏幕上的对齐位置。: Where the component is aligned on the screen.
label.超出时以省略号截断；为 0 时不限制。相对于组件大小。: Longer text is cut short with an ellipsis; 0 means no limit. Relative to the component's size.
label.边距随分辨率自动调整。: The margin adjusts to the resolution.
label.锁屏显示时组件的入场效果。: How the component appears when the lock screen shows.
